name: Ms Katy Blias
title: Psychologist
description: Katy assists clients across all stages in life in navigating life transitions, relationship challenges, workplace stress, grief and loss, school-related difficulties, bullying, trauma, anxiety, and depression.

name: Ms Malavika Mallya
title: Psychologist
description: My practice draws from Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), mindfulness-based approaches, and elements of Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT), interpersonal, psychodynamic and schema therapies. I also work from trauma-informed and neuroaffirming frameworks, tailoring therapy to each person’s individual needs, goals and strengths.

name: Ms Regan Sharp
title: Psychologist
description: LGBTIQA+ mental health with a focus on exploration and affirmation of gender, sex and sexuality. Regan has a special interest in supporting transgender and non-binary folks to thrive, particularly gender affirmation, navigating relationships, and social isolation. Sexual health, intimacy and sex therapy. Experience working with poly, kink and sex worker communities as well as those with ’alternative’ family structures.
specialties: gender affirmation, kink, lgbtiqa+, non-binary, sex, sexual, sexuality, transgender, trauma

name: Ms Sarai Dee
title: Social Worker
description: I work with adults, and have a particular passion for supporting women and gender-diverse people, including those from LGBTQIA+ communities. Trauma and its impacts Sensorimotor Art Therapy combines body awareness with creative expression, working with the understanding that trauma and difficult emotions are often held in the body as well as the mind. My practice is trauma-informed and neuroaffirming, which means I adapt to your unique ways of communicating and processing the world.

name: Ms Savanti Amaratunga
title: Psychologist
description: Savanti works with mental health presentations such as anxiety, depression, trauma, relational difficulties, gender dysphoria and life transitions. Savanti uses interventions such as Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavioural Therapy (DBT), Schema Therapy, relaxation and mindfulness.

name: Ms Tialara Harris
title: Psychologist
description: Her approach is trauma-informed, inclusive, and grounded in evidence-based therapies, including CBT-I, CBT, ACT, relaxation strategies, and motivational interviewing. Tialara is committed to offering a compassionate, responsive, and non-judgmental space, with a particular dedication to supporting LGBTQIA+ clients.

name: Ms Jigisha Sanghvi
title: Counsellor
description: Skilled in clinically proven therapies including Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) and Dialectical Behavioural Therapy (DBT) targeted to treat depression, generalised anxiety disorder, borderline personality disorder, C-PTSD and symptoms of trauma.

name: Ms Salva Crusca
title: Counsellor
description: I am an accredited mental health social worker and trauma counsellor. I provide counselling and evidence based mental health interventions including EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitisation & Reprocessing) therapy. I have a strong interest in the treatment of trauma including Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) and Complex PTSD, sexual abuse, sexual assault. I have worked with adults who have experienced the effects of childhood trauma and with adults who have been in abusive relationships.
